base_protocol.inheritance: Every data role, source hash, slice, feature, architecture, loss, optimizer, seed, endpoint, ECDF, scan, threshold, GO gate, lockbox gate, claim boundary, and no-rescue rule is inherited byte-for-byte in meaning except the two explicit seed-contract and fold-assignment replacements below.

v5_disposition.decision: v5 remains DATA_CONTRACT_NO_GO and is not rewritten or rescued
v5_disposition.reason_for_new_version: The official selected Mode2 topology has 395 unique seed values among 400 runs. Global uniqueness was an unnecessarily strict metadata assumption; repeated simulator seeds are scientifically usable only if every connected run block is confined to one fold.

allowed: HDF5 root keys and Processdata_Labels object shape
selected group existence and SimulationCompleted versus SimulationStopped status
selected processdata/idv_init object shapes and dtypes without value decoding
forbidden_and_not_accessed: any model feature, score, loss, prediction, metric, or outcome

replacement_seed_contract.failure_policy: Any missing/nonpositive/nonintegral seed, any sixth collision, any different owner, or any changed multiplicity is DATA_CONTRACT_NO_GO. Repeated seeds are disclosed simulator identities and are not claimed as independent random realizations.

replacement_folds.graph: Create nodes for run_id 1..100. Add an edge when any selected IDV records for two run IDs share a seed; the four IDVs within one run_id remain one balanced stratification block.
replacement_folds.deterministic_assignment: Sort connected components by descending size then ascending minimum run_id. Repeatedly assign the next whole component to the fold with the smallest current run count, breaking ties by lowest fold index. Sort run IDs within each fold.
replacement_folds.outer_design: For outer fold j use fold j as test, fold (j+1) mod 5 healthy only as threshold calibration, and the other three folds as model/ECDF fit, exactly as the base protocol.

numeric_access_gate: This JSON, its SHA256 sidecar, and its atomic commit record must all exist and agree before any Processdata_Labels, processdata, or idv_init values are decoded.
claim_rule: v5.1 is a transparent metadata-only protocol correction, not a favorable-outcome rerun. It must be reported together with the v5 DATA_CONTRACT_NO_GO.
